purpose: Repair formal rewrite-v2's missing image binding and length inflation in a new lineage only.

evidence.observed_failure: All collection/rewrite delivery was confirmed, but six rewrites exceeded the public length contract and private rejects repeatedly reported no visual inspection or reliance on fixed_final.
evidence.no_relabel_or_replay: Existing v2 quality rejections remain terminal and are not retried under this patch.

future_only_changes.image_binding: Attach the frozen source image to the rewrite request; the rewrite must inspect it.
future_only_changes.compactness: Exactly three observations and comparisons with field-level limits to remain under the fixed public rendering limit.
future_only_changes.local_rejection: Reject claims that the image was unseen/unavailable or that fixed_final was used as evidence.

provider_policy: One separately planned fresh 32-row lineage may use v3 after offline tests; R0/R1/R2 recovery, fresh ledgers, private audits, conversion gate, and no-SFT policy remain mandatory.
